description: Get the current plenary sitting of the Sejm, or the next one if none is in progress, with its number, dates, agenda (porządek dzienny), schedule, voting schedule and current affairs, as plain text.

term.description: Term of the Sejm (kadencja), e.g. 10; defaults to the current term (see get-terms)

name: get-current-proceeding

notice.description: Set when the Sejm API is unavailable and the data comes from a cache; it may be out of date

number.description: Sitting number, the `proceeding`/`sitting` parameter of other tools

title: Get the current plenary sitting
